translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Ra Aepiti Jesus me Bethany
Wonowu raaen me weni mmwaen Passover, nge Jesus a noa Bethany, iwe pwugusaen Lazarus, mwaaen we e aemenewaetae me reen mae noa.
Ra oamoannatae eew mwongoon faaef pwe aan, iwe Martha a tipaengiir reen feeoriun; Lazarus iwe erhai mwaaen kkewe emooat reen Jesus reen table we.
Maria a pwigi eew neoningas e igin cchoaw paniuwaen a aekkitae wooan pirheen Jesus, iwe ooa toafi noa chogin pirheen reen aennirhimwen. Miniwe pwongesaen neowe a rheeoi noa noan iimw we.
Erhai rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun itan Judas Iscariot — mwaaen we epwe fangenoa tinnimaen — a iura pwe,
“Meeta rese chuwaiuw noa neoningas een reen eniupwiugiuw silver iwe nge ra ngaenneer man affayeo minna senaapian?”
E iura miniwe nge saapw iga e faayeeor man affayeo pwe iga iiy erhai man mwoarho. Iiy minne pweipwog tutuun senaapiy nge egaen piraf naiun senaapiy me reen.
Jesus a iura pwe, “Oawsoapw amwagiutiu, nigiti pwe epwe iseni meeta kkomwu aan pwe ammwenen raaenin na ipwe nipwaenipw noa reen.
Pwe rhooa affayeo repwe fasiun yor reemi oanongaen oat, nge ngaang isoapw no rhag reemi oanongaen oat.”
Ra Rhiu Aenneewa Lazarus
Re towunap aeremas ra rongorong pwe Jesus eno Bethany iwe ra noa igiwe, soapw pwonno rhag reen Jesus nge pwonno repwe pwan weri Lazarus, iwe Jesus e aemenewaetae me reen mae noa.
Iwe soamwoonin patere kkewe ra feeori noa aar niunniuwaen pwe repwe pwan niiy noa Lazarus,
pwonno reen Lazarus minne ra igin towunap Jews kka ra toagun saengiir ra noa niugiuniug ngaeni Jesus.
Toonongon Jesus Noan Jerusalem
Mmasetaen iwe eraaen, eew pwuwa temoag a itto tapweei miniwe gupwunon Passover pwe ra rongorong pwe Jesus a itto noan Jerusalem.

Iwe ra pweipwog to paeneaei niu pwe repwene itiwow aewenimmwei Jesus, nge ra gaen aekkepwas pwe, “Aepingepinga Deus! Deus epwe aewenepwuwa aeremas na epwe itto faaen itaen Soamwoon! Deus epwe aewenepwuwa king na aar re Israel!”
Jesus enoa rhuungi erhai donkey a teeotae wooan, taeppen rhag miniwe Pwapwior we e Santus iwe e iura pwe,

content.text: Emwaeri, a itto king we noawumw,
iye e waawa erhai donkey mwittig.”

content: Noan oatowe nge rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun rese metefaaegini miniwe; nge oatowe enoa menaw sefaaen Jesus a ittiw noan nningen nge ra naaen maengiy pwe ina miniwe Pwapwior we e Santus e iura reen, nge e ina wusun miniwe refeeori ngaeni.
Rhooa kkewe reno reen Jesus oatowe e faingiwow Lazarus me noan miniwe paeian nge a aemenewa sefaaeniy tae iwe ra aepesa fetaeneei miniwe a wen.
Ina faaen miniwe pwuwa we a itiwow rhungaeni pwe iga ra rongorong wunuunun kkeman we efeeori.
Iwe Pharisees kkewe ra iura fengaenniy wooar pwe, “Oawwa weri pwe esooar mwo nge eew meeta ne emmwen ngaenigirh! Oaw pipiiy, oanongaen faeinaengiy nge a tapweei!”
Aaemweoi Rhooan Greeks re Kiukkiutta Jesus
Aaemweoi re Greeks reno neeiir rhooawe renoa Jerusalem repwe noa maeipin oaton gupwunon Passover.
Ra noa reen Philip (erhai re Bethsaida e nonno Galilee), iwe ra aengaeni pwe, “Menap, aei mwerhaen rhuungi Jesus.”
Philip a noa a aengaeni Andrew, iwe iir ra noa aengaeni Jesus.
Jesus a paniuwaeniir pwe, “Awa we iye a itto igina pwe miniwe Naiun Aeremas epwene pwae noa minna nningen.
Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi minna wenewenen: ngaere efai faiun wheat ese ppiungtiw nee ppweon nge a mae noa, nge epwe no rhag pwe efai faiun. Iwe ngaere epwe mae noa ina nge epwe towunap uwaan.
Rhooakka re aerhaengi meneweer nge epwe ppiung saengiir, nge rhooakka rese aerhaengi meneweer me noan faeinaengiy ina epwe yo ngaeniir menaw na esooar iaenin.
Iyo na e mwerhaen epwe engaang ngaeniaei epwe tapweaei, pwene naeyi rhooan engaang epwe no reei iga ino ee. Iwe nge minna Semaei epwe fang ssoar ngaeniir ikkina re engaang ngaeniaei.
Jesus a Fioangei Aan Mae Noa
“Igina a waeiraes nee tipaei — meeta ipwe iura? Ipwe iura pwe, ‘Semaei, wosoapw aefengato oaton eei wooai?’ Nge ina rhag ina faaen aaei itto, pwe ipwe toonong noan oaton affayeo eei.
Semaei, pwaeri noa nningen minna itoamw!” Nge eew mangiungiu a ittiw naaeng, “Iya fasiun pwaeri noa nningen, nge ipwe rhiuwen feeori sefaaeniy.”
Pwuwa we re iu igiwe re rongorong mangiungiu we, nge aaemweoi ra iura pwe pacch, aaemweoi re iura pwe, “Erhai angkenus minne e mwaenieniy ngaeni!”
Iwe nge Jesus a aengaeniir pwe, “Saapw aegin ngaang minne mangiungiu naan ittiw me noan naaeng reen, pwe aegin aaemi.
Igina a itto oatowe faeinaengiy epwene apwiung; nge igina mwaaen e soamwoonin faeinaengiy epwene asiuw me wooan nenien.
Aere iya aetaegiasaetae saengi faeinaengiy, nge ipwene pwigiir to oanongeer aeremas reei.” (
Noan aan aepesa minneei, nge a aepesa wunuunun mae na epwe aeni.)
Pwuwa we a iura pwe, “Aemaem anniug e aengaenigemaem pwe Kristus epwe menaw foarhofoarh. Epwe ifa wusun oamw iura pwe mwaaen na Naiun Aeremas epwe aetaegiasaetae? Iyo iiy minne Naiun Aeremas?”

Jesus a iura pwe, “Iiy seram we epwe no faeiyegius fetaen mwo neeimi. Oaw soapwei noa aaemi faaeraeg iga seram e rhiuwen no reemi, pwe roorh ete gonaegaemi; pwe erhai ne e faaeraeg nee roorh nge esoapw giuneei igine e faaeraeg noa ee.

Iwe oawpwe niugiuniug ngaeni seram naan, noan faei oaton aan no reemi, pwe aaemi oawpwe no pwe aeremesaen ne seram.” Aar Aeremas Se Niugiuniug Mwirin aaen Jesus aepesa minneei, a nigitiir pwe a noa wop saengiir.
Inamwo igiwe a feeori oanongaen kkeman kkeei me weni mmweer, nge rese niugiuniug ngaeni,
pwe aegin miniwe mwaeniaen profeta Isaiah epwe pwae noa iwe e iura pwe,

content.text: “Soamwoon, iyo e niugiuniug ngaeni kkepas we aeiya aepesa?
Nge iyo na Soamwoon e pwaeri ngaeni minna maemaewan?”

content: Iwe rese mmwenen niugiuniug, pwe igiwe Isaiah epwan iura pwe,

content.text: “Deus a aeperha noa meseer nge a oarorha noa noan tipeer,
pwonno meseer ete weriwer nge nee tipeer ese metaf,
nge resoapw toagun ngaeniaei, aaen kkepas Deus,

content: Isaiah e aepesa minneei pwe igiwe a weri minna nningen Jesus iwe a fioangei kkepesan.
Oateen mwo nge re towunap soamwooniir Jews ra niugiuniug ngaeni Jesus; nge pwonno reer Pharisees kkewe minne esooar minne re aepesa, pwe rete aerheer wow me noan wutteer Jews.
Re aerhaengi pwe aeremas repwe aepingepingaar mmwaen aaen Deus epwe aepingepingaar.
Petenaen Mwaeniaen Jesus Minne Epwe Kapwiungiu Aeremas
Jesus a kkepas temoag tae nge a iura pwe, “Iyo na e niugiuniug ngaeniaei nge ese niugiuniug ngaeniaei rhag, pwe pwan iyo na efangeto ngaang.
Nge iyo na eweriaei nge epwan weri iyo na efangeto ngaang.
Ngaang itto noan faeinaengiy pwe eew seram, pwe iyo na e niugiuniug ngaeniaei esoapw no noan rorhappiung.
Rhooakka re rongorong mwaeniaei nge rese tapweei, isoapw apwiungiiur. Ngaang ise itto ipwe itto apwiungiu faeinaengiy, pwe itto pwe ipwe aemenewa.
Iyo kena rese aetiwaeyaei nge rese aetiwa mwaeniaei nge eno erhai ina epwe itto apwiungiiur. Iir ina repwe apwiung reen minikka petenaen mwaeniaei wooan minna oarosaen raaen!
Wenewenen minikkeei, pwe saapw tipaei rhag wooan oanongaei, pwe mwaeniaen minna Semaei ina efangeto ngaang, nge e ammwir ngaeniaei meeta ipwe iura me aepesa.
Nge ngaang i giuneei, pwe oasoapwosoapw e aan epwe pwigito menaw na esooar iaenin. Iwe meeta i iura nge ina minna manna Semaei e aengaeniaei pwe ipwe iura.”
